title: FilingJob
description: One filing for the pipeline (ADR-0002 rules 1 and 2; data-plane.md, section 3). The ingester writes it into ingest_ops.job_runs.contract after storing and hashing the files. It holds no paths: the pipeline reads each file at <raw folder>/<cik>/<accession_no>/<name> and hashes it again.

version.description: The contract's version; a change that a reader of version 1 cannot read raises it.

form.description: The form type as the SEC gives it.

known_at.description: The SEC's acceptance time in UTC, to the second (ADR-0007 change 2).

filed_date.description: The SEC's filing date; after 17:30 ET it is the next business day, so it may follow known_at's date.

files.description: The stored files: the primary document and, for an XBRL filing, its instance, schemas and linkbases.

JobFile.description: One stored file of the filing.

name.description: The file name from the SEC's index; never a path, never starting with a dot.

kind.description: What the file is to the pipeline.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the stored bytes, lower-case hex.
